On May 23rd 2018 the EU launched GDPR - General Data Protection Regulation - in fewer words, this forces companies to ask for permission to send you marketing material, set cookies or track you in any way, or hold your data if you haven't specifically agreed to it.

This is a good thing for every internet user in the EU. It means companies cannot hold your data in an unsecured way, cannot send you any offers or marketing material without your express consent nor track or set any cookies on your devices without your consent.

It's quite aggressive and comes with a €20 mil. fine or up to 4% of the total net profit of the company, whichever is higher. It's quite resource intensive to implement, requires the hiring of a specialised GDPR person in the company (for large companies) - called a DPS (Data Protection Specialist).
